decisions.decision: Use struct.pack/unpack for float32 vectors in SQLite chunk_vectors table
decisions.rationale: Avoids external vector database dependencies while keeping retrieval fully local and deterministic

decisions.decision: Pre-registered eligibility rule: <= 1 false injection across general questions and <= 1 irrelevant block across PNA questions
decisions.rationale: Prevents regression against baseline lexical search while evaluating semantic recall gains

decisions.decision: Privacy boundary: no raw vector coordinates or document text in doctor detail or diagnostics
decisions.rationale: Prevents leaking sensitive data into logs or console outputs
